body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An attack targets the creature while it stands within 1 unit of one of your Rite anchors, before rolling. Response (unopposed): Grant +1 to its targeted Defense against that attack.

surges.html: The creature resists up to 2 units of forced movement from the attack.
Reduce its Damage by 1 if it hits.
